environment.description: Production deployment on ECS Fargate with Split.io SDK configured. The 'profile_direct_model_binding' treatment is set to 'on' for all users in the 'default' environment targeting rule (100% rollout). The 'enable_bulk_profile_update' flag is also 'on' at 100%. No request filtering or API gateway validation is in place. Environment variable SPLIT_API_KEY is set to the production SDK key for the 'default' environment.

config.infrastructure: ECS Fargate, ALB with no WAF, no API Gateway
